rules: Record only investigated facts; user reports, hypotheses, confirmed causes and resolutions are distinct.
No credentials, private user data or raw production logs. Reference code symbols/tests and sanitized event names.
Do not mark resolved merely because code was edited. Record validation and remaining limits.
Keep CODEMAP.json current; retain historical records here with date/context. Revalidate historical findings against current code.
Entries below document source inspection; no live service reproduction or runtime correction was performed in this mapping task.

After debugging review route coverage: extend an existing route first, add a distinct route only when needed, merge duplicates and remove stale current-code claims from CODEMAP.json. Historical entries here retain their original context and must not be used as current dependencies without revalidation.
